description.p: MelfPaint is a simple raster image editor for Linux: selection, crop, resize and skew, rotate and flip, pencil, fill, text, eraser, color picker, magnifier, nine brushes, 23 editable shapes, color palette, layers, rulers, gridlines and zoom.
MelfPaint es un editor de imágenes sencillo para Linux: selección, recorte, lápiz, relleno, texto, pinceles, formas, capas y zoom.
Open beta: ribbon toolbar, color picker with RGB/HSV/hex, movable and resizable text box, per-tool sizes, selection context menu, full screen view and Linux packages.
